# GPMI 0.1.1

This release focuses on the GPMI portrait manager and packaging flow.

## Changes

- Added a portrait manager overlay that can be shown while the game is running.
- Added global `P` hotkey support for opening and hiding the portrait manager during gameplay.
- Made the portrait manager independent from the main launcher window so the launcher can be minimized separately.
- Changed the default portrait mod selection to "Do Not Load Mod" and persist that choice across launches.
- Moved the portrait manager close button into the header and added localized text.
- Embedded launcher runtime resources for packaged builds.
- Updated the MSI packaging workflow so release notes can be attached automatically.

## Installer

Download `GPMI-0.1.1.msi` from the release assets.
